subject: Re: Kickoff: BUSTLE - staffing + budget confirmation
body:
Dmitri,

Staffing: Saoirse 70% (TL), Giannis 60% on the Java synthesis core and the SyGuS benchmark rig, Oyin 50% on the TF training pipeline and task mining. That covers M1/M2; M3 latency work may need a short loan from the serving team, which I'll raise with Zeke when we get there.

Budget: Idris has verbally earmarked $120k from the Q3 discretionary compute budget line B-77 for this project, which covers the model retraining sweeps and the synthesis benchmark farm through September. I'm treating that as committed and building the Q3 plan on it. Idris - cc'd - just reply with the paperwork when the Q3 books open.

Near-term compute is small: guidance-model training is single-GPU TensorFlow; the search itself is CPU-heavy, so I'm requesting a 96-vCPU batch pool instead of GPU slots.

Bao
